title: declarative-monitoring-orchestration-terraform-module-with-helm-operator-and-loki-promtail
author: Priya Ramesh
description: Motivation: private installs currently require multiple manual steps to stand up monitoring: a Terraform step to provision Kubernetes infra and persistent volumes, followed by ad-hoc Helm chart installs for Prometheus, Grafana, and a separate log shipping layer (Fluent Bit / Promtail + Loki). Operators reported drift between installs and painful manual upgrades. This PR delivers a single declarative Terraform module that orchestrates Helm Operator-driven installs for the monitoring stack (Prometheus Operator + kube-prometheus, Grafana with a resilient provisioning sidecar, and Loki + Promtail) and includes automated dashboard import, alert rules packaging, versioned migration hooks, and rollback-safe Grafana provisioning.
commits: Initial module scaffold: terraform/modules/monitoring with variables and outputs
Add helmreleases for prometheus-operator, grafana-sidecar, loki, promtail
Implement grafana-provisioner: idempotent dashboard import and retry semantics
Add migration hooks for statefulset PV expansion and grafana provisioning rollbacks
Integration test harness + sample install overlays for on-prem and vpc profiles
Fix: upgrade path for existing installs that used legacy helm values (preserve secrets)
Docs: operator runbook and rollback playbook
ci_checks: integration e2e private install - pass (canary cluster)
review_comments: Marco Alvarez: Can the grafana sidecar handle partial failures during dashboard import? Please add retries and an alert if >3 consecutive failures.
Author (Priya): Added exponential backoff retries and a Prometheus metric grafana_provisioner_failures_total with alerting rule. See grafana-provisioner.yaml and scripts/provisioner-entrypoint.sh
Tess Huang: Terraform state drift was a concern in prior installs. Does the module create deterministic names for HelmReleases and PVs?

Author (Priya): HelmRelease names are now deterministic (prefixes based on install_id) and PV claims include a stable naming template to make lifecycle predictable. Added migration hook docs for PV expansion.
Daniel Okoye: CI e2e flaked on PVC scheduling in the canary cluster. Recommend gating upgrade job on PV-provisioner readiness.
Author (Priya): Added readiness check and a pipeline gate step; updated e2e to wait for storage class provisioning and included retries in the installer overlay.
merge: merged via squash by Marco Alvarez after approvals from reviewers; commit message: 'monitoring: add terraform orchestration and helm-driven monitoring stack (Prometheus/Grafana/Loki) with safe grafana provisioning and rollback hooks'
release_notes: Added a declarative monitoring module for private installs: includes Prometheus Operator + kube-prometheus, Grafana with idempotent provisioning sidecar, Loki + Promtail for logs, Terraform module to orchestrate HelmReleases, versioned dashboards, and rollback-safe migration hooks. Operators: see docs/operator-runbook/monitoring-install.md for upgrade and rollback steps.
